central_theme: Family relationships, observation, humor, and everyday mindfulness

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: The humorous situations caused by absent-mindedness in daily domestic life.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Simple solutions are often right in front of us if we observe calmly rather than panicking.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Empathy towards elders, observant behavior in children, and shared family affection.

child_nodes.title: Beginning
child_nodes.details: Papa misplaces his reading spectacles and begins a frantic household search.

child_nodes.title: Mid-point
child_nodes.details: Family members assist by searching pockets, drawers, tables, and under chairs.

child_nodes.title: Climax
child_nodes.details: An observant young child notices the spectacles resting on top of Papa's forehead.

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: Laughter fills the room as Papa realizes his mistake and thanks his child.

child_nodes.title: Papa
child_nodes.details: Absent-minded, affectionate father who relies heavily on reading glasses.

child_nodes.title: Observant Child
child_nodes.details: Attentive, calm, and helpful young narrator who solves the domestic mystery.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Spectacles, glanced, misplaced, frantic, anxious, observant.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Three-syllable word 'spec-ta-cles'; soft ending in 'glanced' (/t/ sound).

child_nodes.title: Nouns & Noun Phrases
child_nodes.details: Identification of concrete nouns (glasses, chair, pocket) and plural forms.

child_nodes.title: Contractions
child_nodes.details: Usage of can't (cannot), where's (where is), he's (he is).

child_nodes.title: Sentence Types
child_nodes.details: Interrogative questions ('Where are my glasses?') and Exclamatory statements.
